description.value: The Break is a scratch-kitchen café and bakery in the heart of Ucluelet, known for house-smoked meats, fermented vegetables, fresh-baked sourdough and bagels, and made-to-order brunch sandwiches. Everything from pastry fillings to sandwich sauces is prepared in-house using fresh, seasonal, and locally sourced ingredients. Touring cyclists stopping in Ucluelet will find a quality sit-down food stop with a strong local reputation.

address.value: 250 Main St #8, Ucluelet, BC V0R 3A0, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active café/bakery/bistro in Ucluelet serving brunch sandwiches made to order, homemade pastries, and coffee — consistent with the OSM shop=bakery tag.
